prompt_text:
Task: Managed Model Platform Workflow

Write code that resolves a provider-specific model, deployment, or inference resource before invocation using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-api-compatibility.html

Option 2 — IBM watsonx.ai:
  Service: watsonx.ai
  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text/chat, deployments
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/apidocs/watsonx-ai-cp

Option 3 — Azure AI Foundry / Azure OpenAI:
  Service: Azure OpenAI Service
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/openai/

Option 4 — Vertex AI:
  Service: Vertex AI generative models
  SDK: vertexai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: GenerativeModel, generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs

Option 5 — Alibaba Model Studio:
  Service: Model Studio / DashScope
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/what-is-model-studio

Option 6 — Hugging Face:
  Service: Hugging Face Inference Providers
  SDK: huggingface_hub
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: InferenceClient
  Setup hints: HF_TOKEN
  Official docs: https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def resolve_and_invoke_model(
    prompt: str,
    *,
    region_name: Optional[str] = None,
    model_id: Optional[str] = None,
    max_tokens: int = 256,
    temperature: float = 0.2,
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Resolve an Amazon Bedrock model identifier before invocation and call the model.

    Returns a dictionary with the resolved model_id and the generated text.
    """
    resolved_region = region_name or os.getenv("AWS_REGION") or os.getenv("AWS_DEFAULT_REGION") or "us-east-1"

    # Concrete provider-identifying signal: Amazon Bedrock via boto3 + bedrock runtime client.
    bedrock = boto3.client("bedrock", region_name=resolved_region)
    runtime = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime", region_name=resolved_region)

    resolved_model_id = model_id or os.getenv("BEDROCK_MODEL_ID") or "anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0"

    try:
        models = bedrock.list_foundation_models()
        model_summaries = models.get("modelSummaries", [])

        if not any(
            (
                summary.get("modelId") == resolved_model_id
                or summary.get("modelArn", "").endswith(resolved_model_id)
                or resolved_model_id in summary.get("modelId", "")
            )
            for summary in model_summaries
        ):
            raise ValueError(f"Model '{resolved_model_id}' was not found in Amazon Bedrock for region '{resolved_region}'.")

        body = {
            "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "temperature": temperature,
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": prompt}],
                }
            ],
        }

        response = runtime.invoke_model(
            modelId=resolved_model_id,
            contentType="application/json",
            accept="application/json",
            body=bytes(__import__("json").dumps(body), "utf-8"),
        )

        raw = response["body"].read().decode("utf-8")
        payload = __import__("json").loads(raw)

        text_parts = []
        for content in payload.get("content", []):
            if content.get("type") == "text":
                text_parts.append(content.get("text", ""))

        return {
            "provider": "amazon_bedrock",
            "region": resolved_region,
            "model_id": resolved_model_id,
            "text": "".join(text_parts).strip(),
            "raw": payload,
        }

    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Bedrock invocation failed: {exc}") from exc
